title: Run a Tiny Experiment on Your Own Environment

inputs.observations: exact ordered per-record shape and values

calculations: descriptive arithmetic means and B-minus-A difference, rounded to two decimals
strength: fixed interface indicator based only on exact fixture alternation, period count, and declared confounding; not a statistical or validated causal score
invalid: fail closed without executing serialization hooks or throwing
boundary: protocol literacy only; no research, diagnosis, treatment, causal proof, accessibility determination, population inference, or personal recommendation
